name: Digital Modes (FT8 / FT4 / FT2 / JT65 / JT9 / JT4 / Q65 / FST4 / WSPR / FST4W)
description: FT8, FT4, JT65, JT9, WSPR, and (experimental, not yet tested on the air) FT2, JT4, Q65, FST4 and FST4W inside Kainos: band activity, automatic QSO sequencing and an ADIF log, in the Kainos look. Decoding by WSJT-X's jt9 (included).
author: Justin Cron K7JUS
